answer: Sybils die of accounting, not policing: each new agent must burn a verifiable plume of compute bound to one enclave serial, and that receipt becomes spendable credit only after unrelated agents co-sign escrow with it. A whisper of collusion voids the batch, because co-signers forfeit their matured stake. Spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand real burns and a thousand honest counterparties, so the comet of cheap identities never forms.
